edge_sample.source_text: definition $L_2$ norm: For a function $h:{\mathbb F}_q^n\to{\mathbb C}$, define its $L_2$ norm by \[ \|h\|_2 \mathrel{\mathop:}= \left({\mathbb E}_{x\in{\mathbb F}_q^n}\left[\left\lvert{h(x)}\right\rvert^2\right]\right)^{1/2} = \sqrt{\langle h, h \rangle}. \]
